findings.title: JSON null bypasses Person SQL ownership and request-binding checks
findings.repro: Under existing qualified gateway/policy, retain valid actor/trip/op SQL arguments but set request.tripId=null, operationId=null or dataOwnership=null. Each returns a newly inserted unlinked Person and immutable receipt. Owning IF uses <> on extracted nullable text, so expression becomes SQL NULL, not true. Probes run in BEGIN/ROLLBACK on disposable PG, no retained test writes.
findings.impact: Invalid unbound/unclassified authored requests can mutate through owning SQL and create receipts violating its fixed typed contract. Reviewed HTTP/Pg typed validation prevents direct current HTTP reachability, but SQL authority must fail closed independently.
findings.fix: Use null-safe exact comparisons plus required JSON types/non-null UUID bindings; add actual SQL negatives and regenerate checked postimage/rollback.
